IVIVE Hepatic Clearance — BCR-ABL1 TKI Panel — Scales measured microsomal CLint to predicted human hepatic clearance for 4 TKIs using the well-stirred liver model.

Input: 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs with CLint (Dasatinib 220, Bosutinib 60, Imatinib 25, Nilotinib 12 μL/min/mg), fu_plasma (0.04, 0.03, 0.04, 0.01), fu_mic = 1.0, Qh = 20.7 mL/min/kg
Key steps:

CLint scaling → fu_mic correction + microsomal protein binding normalization → intrinsic clearance per compound
Well-stirred model: CLh = Qh × (fu_plasma × CLint_scaled) / (Qh + fu_plasma × CLint_scaled) → predicted CLh (mL/min/kg) + hepatic extraction ratio (EH) per TKI


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh + EH per compound) + clearance_summary.json (compounds ranked by EH + model parameters used)

Decision gate: EH > 0.7 = high-extraction TKI (expect high first-pass effect, oral bioavailability risk — flag for formulation review); EH < 0.3 = low-extraction (CLh sensitive to fu_plasma — monitor protein binding variability across patient populations).

Input: Reference SMILES — Imatinib, Dasatinib, Bosutinib, Asciminib (4 actives); Library SMILES — Gleevec-analog-1, Ponatinib, Terfenadine, Acetaminophen; min_features = 3
Key steps:

Pharmacophore → derives consensus features (H-bond donors/acceptors, hydrophobic centers, aromatic rings, positive ionizable) from the 4 ABL1 inhibitor SMILES
Pharmacophore Alignment → aligns each library compound to the model, scores by feature-match count and spatial overlap, flags hits meeting min_features ≥ 3


Expected output: Filtered hits table (compound ID + feature-match score + aligned pose), ranked SMILES/SDF of passing compounds, and a JSON/CSV summary of matched vs. rejected library entries

Decision gate: Hits must satisfy ≥ 3 pharmacophoric features with acceptable 3D overlay RMSD — Ponatinib and Gleevec-analog-1 are expected to pass; Acetaminophen (MW 151, minimal features) and Terfenadine (no kinase-like hinge binder) are predicted to fail, confirming model selectivity for ABL1-relevant scaffolds.

CSV parser → normalizes BCR-ABL1 IC50 (nM→µM unit harmonization) + computes selectivity window (hERG IC50 / BCR-ABL1 IC50) per compound
Composite scorer → weighted rank score (potency 60% + cardiac safety 40%), flags hERG IC50 < 1 µM as cardiac risk (CPD003, CPD005, CPD009, CPD010, CPD014)
Report generator → ranked table + HTML dashboard with risk-tier color coding (green / amber / red)


Expected output: ranked_compounds.csv (rank, composite score, selectivity window, risk tier) + HTML report (interactive ranked table) + summary.json (campaign-level statistics)
